name: Komaba-Todaimae
tagline: Shibuya in 4 minutes and Shinjuku in 14 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Meguro City, where Keio run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 28 minutes to Otemachi, 14 minutes to Shinjuku, 4 minutes to Shibuya and 30 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 33.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 33.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 30 m to 38.4 m, a difference of 8.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 1 clinic and 3 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 田中舘医院, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is Kijima E.N.T. & Pediatric Clinic, about 8 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Keio Inokashira Line.
congestion: Keio Inokashira Line runs at 125% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 池ノ上→駒場東大前, which includes this station. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000, 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000, 1LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000 and 2LDK ¥300,000 to ¥310,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Komaba-Todaimae, but Shinsen is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 3 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Keio Inokashira Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
